title: Baby Boom
description: A Manhattan career woman (Diane Keaton) with a live-in boyfriend (Harold Ramis) suddenly inherits a baby girl and moves to Vermont.

title: The Magnificent Seven
description: A man in black (Yul Brynner) recruits six hired guns to lead Mexican villagers against the gang of an outlaw (Eli Wallach).

title: The Misfits
description: A divorcee (Marilyn Monroe) joins an old cowboy (Clark Gable) and his partners rounding up wild horses for dog food.

title: Dances With Wolves
description: Costner's epic vision of the American frontier as seen through the eyes of a 19th-century U.S. Cavalry officer.

title: Mad Max

description: Scientists use the mangled remains of a dead police officer to create the ultimate crime-fighter -- an indestructible cyborg.
